annotations.title: EU e-invoice check: rules, VAT numbers in VIES and IBAN for XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, UBL

description: Check whether an EU e-invoice is usable, in one call: send XRechnung, ZUGFeRD / Factur-X or UBL XML by URL, as text or as a file. Runs a subset of the EN 16931 and XRechnung rules, looks up seller and buyer VAT numbers in EU VIES, checks the IBAN and returns the invoice as JSON with pass, review or fail. No AI; not the official validator. Use when an e-invoice arrives, before booking or paying it; PDF or scanned invoices: invoice_check. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

profile.description: auto (default: the German XRechnung rules run when the file names XRechnung), xrechnung or en16931

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the e-invoice: an XML file or a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (or send `xml`, or the file in a POST body)

xml.description: The e-invoice XML as text (CII or UBL), up to 5 MB in a POST body
